Application Materials.content:
Supporting documents are to be uploaded under the “Documents Upload” section before online submission:
1. Scanned copy of identity card (colour - front and back) OR passport (for international students)
2. Degree certificate(s)/scroll(s) OR Student Status letter stating the expected date of completion of programme
3. Official updated transcript of academic records/ consolidated and semesters’ mark sheet from each University, Polytechnic or College attended
4. Updated Curriculum Vitae
5. Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) Test Scores (for students based overseas)
6. TOEFL/ IELTS score report OR letter stating medium of instruction (for students based overseas)
7. A copy of Employment Pass (for international applicants working in Singapore)
8. Professional certificates (optional)
9. Testimonials from the employer (where relevant)
Applicants whose applications are successful and offered admission must produce the original or certified true copies of above documents for verification during Registration (Part Two), conducted on-site in the NUS-ISS Campus.

Interview Requirements.content:
- Have received a favourable assessment at admissions interview conducted by NUS-ISS.
- The NUS-ISS Entrance Test or GRE and interview requirements will be waived for applicants with relevant Bachelor's degrees from NUS, NTU, SMU and SUTD with Distinction, Second Upper or above Honours.
- NUS-ISS Graduate Diploma in Systems Analysis alumni who wishes to apply to NUS-ISS Master of Technology programmes may be waived of Entrance Test/GRE and interview requirement if they meet the GPA's requirements.

Academic Requirements.content:
- **Bachelor's degree preferably in Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Management Science, Operational Research, Science or Engineering and a grade point average of at least B**.
- **Preferably two years of relevant working experience**.
- Work experience is preferably two years of relevant working experience in fields like IT, engineering and various scientific domains.
- Applicants with highly relevant degrees in **Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Econometrics, Operations Research or similar**, with consistently good academic records may be granted a work experience waiver.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
- **An acceptable GRE score (overseas applicants)** or pass NUS-ISS Entrance Test.
- The NUS-ISS Entrance Test or GRE and interview requirements will be waived for applicants with relevant Bachelor's degrees from NUS, NTU, SMU and SUTD with Distinction, Second Upper or above Honours.
- NUS-ISS Graduate Diploma in Systems Analysis alumni who wishes to apply to NUS-ISS Master of Technology programmes may be waived of Entrance Test/GRE and interview requirement if they meet the GPA's requirements.
- International applicants residing overseas are required to submit GRE as evidence to demonstrate their academic capability.
- A minimum GRE score of **320 (verbal & quantitative)** and **3.5 (analytical)** is recommended, within **5 years validity**.
- It is mandatory to include the Institution code of NUS-ISS for GRE. **Code: 1941**.
- Applicants who have significant work experience relevant to their intended area of study may be considered for admission even if they do not meet the recommended GRE scores (upon submission). Please note that school projects, internships and enrichment programmes do not count as work experience.
- Applications will not be processed if GRE is not submitted.
- Applicants residing in Singapore will be required to pass an Entrance Test administered face-to-face in NUS-ISS.
- Local applicants may opt to submit GREs instead of taking the Entrance Test in which case the same conditions apply as above.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
- Applicants must demonstrate proficiency in the English Language (written and spoken).
- Applicants who graduated from universities where English is not the medium of instruction should submit TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) or IELTS (International English Language Testing System) score as evidence of their proficiency in the English language.
| Test | Minimum score |
| --- | --- |
| **TOEFL** | Internet-based test (**85 of 120**) |
| **IELTS** | Result of **6.0** |
- Applicants taking the TOEFL iBT from 21 January 2026 onwards will continue to be assessed on the 0 - 120 grading scale.
- It is mandatory to include the Institution code of NUS-ISS for **TOEFL (Code: 2432)**.
- TOEFL and IELTS are only valid for **two years from the test date** and the validity should not expire before the beginning of the application period for the coursework programme.
- NUS only accepts TOEFL iBT scores from a single test date, not MyBest scores.

Program Overview.content:
The NUS Master of Technology in Enterprise Business Analytics programme (MTech EBAC) is crafted to meet the industry's need for data scientists and machine learning specialists, with a focus on advancing enterprises through data and AI. The business analytics course is a gateway to specialist, expert and leadership positions in data science.
- Duration: Full-time 1 year (2 semesters); Part-time 2 years (4 semesters).
- MTech EBAC offers holistic training in key aspects of data science and AI, from exploratory data analysis and predictive modelling to natural language processing, recommender systems and big data engineering.
- Professionals will be equipped with technical expertise to harness data, machine learning and enabling technologies to develop and deploy effective data-driven solutions that enhance decision-making, optimise operations, drive profitability and elevate user experiences within enterprises.
- Recognition: Top student is awarded the IBM Medal and Book Prize; Best Project Prize.
- This programme is suited for professionals looking to build or deepen expertise in data science, business analytics, and AI, and take on specialist or leadership roles in data-driven functions. It is also ideal for those who want to apply data and machine learning to solve business problems and improve decision-making.
Graduates of the enterprise business analytics course will be capable of undertaking tasks such as discovering insights from data; applying concepts and techniques to solve major business problems; designing and customizing marketing campaigns through efficient targeting; analysing sales channels; optimising the marketing mix of their organisations; improving decision-making to increase returns on investments; predicting future profitability; and automating production fault detection in manufacturing using predictive modelling.
Learning outcomes include helping enterprises move towards a stronger emphasis on computer tools and statistical and machine learning techniques to develop high-performance analytics capability; translating massive and complex unstructured data into insights; producing predictive models to solve problems across business functions and units; and contributing to more effective business strategies and plans for sustainable growth and competitive advantage.
MTech EBAC candidates must successfully complete the following business analytics course components to be awarded the degree:
- **Fundamental** - Complete 2 Graduate Certificates.
- **Specialist** - Complete 2 of 5 Graduate Certificates.
Fundamental analytics areas include Analytics Project Management and Business Analytics Practice. Specialist analytics areas include Customer Analytics, Big Data Analytics, Practical Language Processing, Specialised Predictive Modelling & Forecasting, and Intelligent Financial Risk Management.
A central element of the MTech programme is the project module. Student projects for MTech Enterprise in Business Analytics Course students will include intense full time engagement of 5 months with companies for full time students. For part-time students the capstone engagement will be for 7-12 months. Students are allowed to conduct their project as a team-based internship if desired. The expected commitment for the project is 30 man-days per team member. Objectives include practising new technical skills in a real industry environment and applying tools, methods and techniques learnt.
As an MTech EBAC graduate, students will be prepared for specialist, expert and leadership roles in enterprise business analytics to create business value through strategic use of data, visualisation methods, modelling techniques and frontline tools. Career prospects include Business Analytics Manager, Data Scientist and Architect, Business Analyst, Optimisation Strategy Consultant, Business Intelligence and Performance Management Consultant, Enterprise Intelligence Manager, Market Intelligence Analyst, CRM Data Analyst, Risk Analyst, Marketing Analyst, and Big Data Analyst.
MTech alumni are pursuing their careers at global organisations including Accenture, Creative Technology, DBS Bank, Defence Science & Technology Agency, Deutsche Bank AG, Fuji Xerox Asia Pacific, HP Singapore, IBM Singapore, Infocomm Development Authority of Singapore, Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore, Jurong Port, Microsoft, Murex, NCS, NEC Asia Pacific, NTUC, OCBC Bank, Revolution Analytics, Singapore Telecommunications, Standard Chartered Bank, Starhub, ST Electronics, and Tata Consultancy Services.
The [NUS-ISS Career Services Office](https://www.iss.nus.edu.sg/graduate-programmes/career-services) helps students to match jobs based on their skills and experience. There will be bi-yearly Career Fairs held for students and graduates to network with employers. For fresh graduates with no work experience, the average salary starts from S$4,000 onwards. Graduates with more than 3 years of work experience can expect a starting pay of S$6,000 and above.
Teaching staff have more than 20 years of industry experience.

Curriculum.content:
Next Intake: Jan 2027 (Part-Time). Duration: Full-time 1 year (2 semesters); Part-time 2 years (4 semesters).
MTech EBAC candidates must successfully complete the following business analytics course components to be awarded the degree:
- **Fundamental** - Complete 2 Graduate Certificates
- **Specialist** - Complete 2 of 5 Graduate Certificates
Fundamental Analytics Areas:
- Analytics Project Management courses: Statistics for Business II; Data Storytelling; Data Management for Analytics; Managing Business Analytics Projects.
- Business Analytics Practice courses: Data Analytics Process and Best Practices II; Statistics in Action: Driving Data Insights; Predictive Analytics - Insights of Trends and Irregularities; Text Analytics.
Specialist Analytics Areas:
- Customer Analytics courses: Customer Analytics; Advanced Customer Analytics; Campaign Analytics.
- Big Data Analytics courses: Big Data Engineering for Analytics; Recommender Systems; Processing Big Data for Analytics.
- Practical Language Processing courses: Text Analytics; New Media and Sentiment Mining; Text Processing using Machine Learning; Conversational UIs.
- Specialised Predictive Modelling & Forecasting courses: Complex Predictive Modelling & Forecasting; Product & Pricing Analytics; Analytics for Commercial Excellence.
- Intelligent Financial Risk Management courses: Advanced Machine Learning for Financial Services; Explainable & Responsible AI for Finance; Credit Risk Modelling and Analytics; Alternative Data for Fintech Innovation.
A central element of the MTech programme is the project module. Student projects for MTech Enterprise in Business Analytics Course students will include intense full time engagement of **5 months** with companies for full time students. For part-time students the capstone engagement will be for **7-12 months**. Students are allowed to conduct their project as a team-based internship if desired. The expected commitment for the project is **30 man-days per team member**. In addition, students will need to attend a mandatory **4 day** course - [Data Science Solutions Implementation](https://www.iss.nus.edu.sg/executive-education/course/detail/data-science-solutions--implementation/data-science).
Full-time timetable:
- Year 1 Semester 1 (Jul - Nov): **EBA5001: Analytics Project Management (compulsory)** - Statistics for Business II; Data Storytelling; Data Management for Analytics; Managing Business Analytics Projects. **EBA5002: Business Analytics Practice (compulsory)** - Data Analytics Process and Best Practice II; Statistics in Action: Driving Data Insights; Predictive Analytics - Insights of Trends and Irregularities; Text Analytics.
- Year 1 Semester 2 (Jan - Mar): Choose **ONE** from **EBA5003: Customer Analytics** - Customer Analytics; Advanced Customer Analytics; Campaign Analytics, or **EBA5006: Big Data Analytics** - Big Data Engineering for Analytics; Recommender Systems; Processing Big Data for Analytics. Choose **ONE** from **EBA5004: Practical Language Processing** - New Media and Sentiment Mining; Text Processing Using Machine Learning; Conversational UIs, **EBA5005: Specialised Predictive Modelling and Forecasting** - Complex Predictive Modelling & Forecasting; Product & Pricing Analytics; Analytics for Commercial Excellence, or **EBA5008: Intelligent Financial Risk Management** - Advanced Machine Learning for Financial Services; Explainable & Responsible AI for Finance; Credit Risk Modelling and Analytics; Alternative Data for Fintech Innovation.
- Year 1 Semester 2 (Mar - Jul/Aug): **Team-based Internship or Off-site Project** - hands-on project with external organisation; assessment by project, presentation & report.
Part-time timetable:
- Year 1 Semester 1 (Jan - May): **EBA5001: Analytics Project Management (compulsory)** - Statistics for Business II; Data Storytelling; Data Management for Analytics; Managing Business Analytics Projects.
- Year 1 Semester 2 (Jul - Nov): **EBA5002: Business Analytics Practice (compulsory)** - Data Analytics Process and Best Practice II; Statistics in Action: Driving Data Insights; Predictive Analytics - Insights of Trends and Irregularities; Text Analytics.
- Year 2 Semester 1 (Jan - May): Choose **ONE** from **EBA5003: Customer Analytics** - Customer Analytics; Advanced Customer Analytics; Campaign Analytics, or **EBA5006: Big Data Analytics** - Big Data Engineering for Analytics; Recommender Systems; Processing Big Data for Analytics.
- Year 2 Semester 2 (Jul - Nov): Choose **ONE** from **EBA5004: Practical Language Processing** - New Media and Sentiment Mining; Text Processing Using Machine Learning; Conversational UIs, **EBA5005: Specialised Predictive Modelling and Forecasting** - Complex Predictive Modelling & Forecasting; Product & Pricing Analytics; Analytics for Commercial Excellence, or **EBA5008: Intelligent Financial Risk Management** - Advanced Machine Learning for Financial Services; Explainable & Responsible AI for Finance; Credit Risk Modelling and Analytics; Alternative Data for Fintech Innovation.
- Year 2 Semester 1-2 (Mar - Sep): **Team-based Internship or Off-site Project** - hands-on project with external organisation; assessment by project, presentation & report.
Students are evaluated through a combination of course work, project work and examinations. All students are required to complete a three-hour examination for each fundamental and specialist module taken.

Cost of Attendance.content:
Below is a list of estimated expenditure a single student may likely incur during his or her stay in Singapore. These amounts will vary accordingly depending on your personal needs and lifestyle pattern.
| Estimated Cost (Per Month) | On-Campus | Off-Campus |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Accommodation** | S$500 – S$900* | S$650 – S$1800* |
| **Food (3 meals a day)** | S$300 – S$500 | S$400 – S$800 |
| **Public Transport** | S$100 – S$200 | S$200 – S$300 |
| **Personal expenses (Telecommunication, toiletries, clothing etc.)** | S$300 – S$500 | S$300 – S$500 |
| **Total:** | S$1,200 – S$2,100^ | S$1,550 – S$3,400^ |
Please note that this sample only includes expenses for your daily essentials and does not account for non-essentials and major items such as shopping, entertainment, computers, electronic/communication devices, travel plans, etc.
* Actual cost depends on type of residence and type of room. For the hostel fees you may refer to the Office of Student Affairs [Hostel rate](http://nus.edu.sg/osa/housing/graduate/hostel-and-meal-plan-rates.html) website. Coursework graduate students are advised to budget and source for [off-campus accommodation](https://nus.edu.sg/osa/student-services/hostel-admission/other-accommodation) as priority will be accorded to full-time research students and the demand for on campus housing in general exceeds supply. Please refer to the eligibility conditions [here](https://nus.edu.sg/osa/student-services/hostel-admission/graduate/eligibility).

Financial Aid.content:
- **NUS-ISS ASEAN Merit-Based Study Award**: A partial scholarship initiative for students enrolled in NUS-ISS' Masters in Technology programmes. This merit-based award covers **40% of the tuition fees**. Applicants must be citizens or residents of ASEAN countries (excluding Singapore) and must demonstrate strong academic performance, leadership qualities, and preferably relevant work experience. Financial need is not a required criterion. Successful applicants must maintain good conduct and a **GPA above 3.0 each semester**. The award will be available from **Academic Year 2025/26, Semester 1**.
- **SG Digital Scholarship**: NUS-ISS Masters programmes are eligible for the **[IMDA SG Digital Scholarship (Postgraduate)](https://ddec1-0-en-ctp.trendmicro.com/wis/clicktime/v1/query?url=https%3a%2f%2fwww.imda.gov.sg%2fSingapore%2dDigital%2dScholarship%2dpostgraduate&umid=18db5011-a5d3-4a8e-bc63-fb82591b8e2f&auth=8d3ccd473d52f326e51c0f75cb32c9541898e5d5-1e42c0addd789e154860201f3d3d9a9dbae89633)**, including **Master of Technology in Enterprise Business Analytics**. Available for both full-time and part-time Masters programmes, scholarship details and eligibility can be found [here](https://ddec1-0-en-ctp.trendmicro.com/wis/clicktime/v1/query?url=https%3a%2f%2fwww.imda.gov.sg%2fSingapore%2dDigital%2dScholarship%2dpostgraduate&umid=18db5011-a5d3-4a8e-bc63-fb82591b8e2f&auth=8d3ccd473d52f326e51c0f75cb32c9541898e5d5-1e42c0addd789e154860201f3d3d9a9dbae89633).

Multiple Applications.content:
Applicants are allowed to apply to multiple programmes based on interest. However, you can only enrol in one programme. For applicants who are undecided, I recommend submitting multiple applications. This would give you more choices and may increase your probability of admission. Applications for different programmes are reviewed by different admissions committees, and they have no impact on each other. As such, you may want separately prepare your application for each programme to best emphasise your fit for a programme. Also, please note that **each application would incur a separate application fee**.
If you apply for multiple programmes within the same application period, please create all applications and rank them in order of preference. Please note that they cannot be modified after submission. Your preferences will only be considered if you are applying to multiple programmes offered by the same School, Faculty or College. As your preferences cannot be changed after submission of application, please finalise your order of preference before submitting your application (i.e. when the Application Status is at “Pending online submission”). Your preference will not be a consideration if you are applying for programmes offered by different Departments or Schools.

Conditional Admission Policy.content:
Under the **Policy for Matriculation of Stackable Programme Students**:
- Students may apply for matriculation after completing all the required GradCerts and should meet a **minimum CAP of 3.0** to apply, in addition to all other NUS/ISS requirements.
- Students may apply for matriculation while waiting for the results of their final GradCert. In such cases, students may be offered **conditional entry subject to meeting the minimum CAP of 3.0** after their results are released.
- Students on conditional entry may start their Capstone projects. Students will **not** be granted conditional entry to start an Internship.
